name: Enforced Mercy
body:
School enchantment (compulsion) [good, mind-affecting]; Level bard 2, mesmerist 2, sorcerer/wizard 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one creature
Duration 1 round/level (D)
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You utter a powerful command, forcing the target creature to fight in a more merciful manner. If the creature fails their Will save, they will deal nonlethal damage with their attacks, avoid using lethal spells or other abilities, and will not attack a helpless target.
